supportedRange: DOCX body top-level freeforms with a safely editable original DrawingML path model and no shape rotation or flips.

Insert an integer lattice point on an existing straight lnTo edge or the closing edge before close; remove an existing lnTo vertex while retaining at least two vertices for an open subpath and three for a closed subpath.
Preserve source path command identity and order, close semantics, path attributes, viewport, and all untouched XML and OPC parts.
safetyBoundary: Only paths accepted by the existing safe DrawingML model expose vertex operations; transformed shapes, Ink paths, unsupported source metadata, and malformed paths fail closed.
Insertion is limited to existing straight line edges and integer coordinates inside the path viewport; curve subdivision and transformed-path editing are outside this issue.
Deletion is limited to lnTo commands and is rejected when it would leave fewer than two open or three closed vertices.
